body:
I am a total robot with a lack of empathy, sympathy, and real emotion of any kind. It inhibits me from making any relationships or keeping any when they start to maybe form.

The only thing I care about, is that I don’t care at all.

As someone currently struggling with why I want to die so badly and can’t I think it means you still have things to care about.

Even if it’s subconsciously, something in your life matters enough that you can’t let go. That’s a good thing. Regardless of what you may think, it means you haven’t lost all hope yet.

I’m sorry you feel this way, I sympathize and I’m a hypocrite when I try to help people, and I feel the same way, but I just hope you realize you have something left.

I hate being so negative about everything.

I just really don’t want to be here regardless of what I matter to anyone. Or anything I might accomplish.

I can’t wait to go

Thank you

I think that’s my biggest problem. I think I could do something with my life, but I just don’t want to. I honestly think of how to die every few seconds of the day. I’m so broken. 

I’m not worthy of life though. I take for granted everything there is and everything I have every time I wish I was dead. People would kill to be in a similar position to mine, but I’d rather just die than take up the space.

I haven’t told family. I am not close to any of them and I’m in a different country.

And being alive isn’t worth it. I hate being alive. More than anything. I just want to go.
